title: OME-Zarr Converter
description: Convert a microscopy TIFF, OME-TIFF, PNG or JPEG sequence, or NIfTI image to a multiscale OME-Zarr (OME-NGFF 0.4 or 0.5).

convert.title: Convert to OME-Zarr
convert.description: Write the image as a multiscale OME-Zarr pyramid that keeps its voxel sizes, units, channels and channel names, and return it as one archive (.ozx for 0.5, .ome.zarr.zip for 0.4) with a JSON conversion report.

image.description: One TIFF, OME-TIFF or NIfTI file, or a sequence of single-page TIFF, PNG or JPEG files (one per Z plane)

method.description: Pyramid downsampling: 2 x 2 mean for intensity images, nearest for label images

chunk.description: Chunk size in Y and X, in pixels; the pyramid halves until the image fits one chunk
